Our client is one of the leading multinational food and drink processing corporation. Being one of the largest food company in the world, company has strategic programs of regional platform management and optimization.
 We are looking for more skilled PowerBI developer who fully understand PowerBI environment with all its features and capabilities including integrations. The client's PowerBi environment is very complex and leveraging all build-in capabilities, not only reporting.
 🔹 Key Responsibilities 
 • Develop end to end Power BI reports, dashboards, and data models
 • Create DAX measures, KPIs, and interactive visualizations
 • Transform and cleanse data using Power Query and Snowflake
 • Optimize report performance and complex SQL queries
 • Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting reliability
 • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes
 🔹 Requirements 
8+ years of relevant experience as a senior Developer in mining data as a data analyst
Proven analytics skills, including mining, evaluation, and visualization
Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
Strong SQL or Excel skills, with an aptitude for learning other analytics tools
Strong PowerBI skills, experience of data visualization and providing reports to different levels of management
Knowledge of cloud-based platforms (Azure, SharePoint)
 - Advanced data gathering skills from multitype sources
 - Advanced data manipulation skills
 - Advanced queries optimization skills
 - Advanced reporting skills
 - Integration skills including source control
 - PowerBI operational skills (monitoring, issue fixing, etc.)
 Nice to have: 
 Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in mathematics, computer science, economics, or statistics
 Proven success in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
 📩 Interested? Send me your updated CV in English or apply directly through LinkedIn.
